description: Header file defining a thread-safe, synchronized queue template class 'Queue' using Starboard primitives, including methods for polling, getting, timed getting, putting, waking, removing, clearing, and size querying.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: A synchronized, blocking queue template class for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls for an item, returning default T if none available.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Blocks until an item is available or the queue is woken up.

methods.name: GetTimed
methods.description: Blocks until an item is available, timeout expires, or woken up.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Pushes a value onto the queue and signals a waiter.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes one waiting thread without adding an item.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes all instances of a specific value from the queue.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue.
